families.discovery: Inspect luminance independently of hue, structure and regional descriptors.
families.validation: Training-calibrated Y-mean normalization or reflection; no-op paired control; same frozen model and reserved confirmation.
families.limitations: Engineering adaptation of photometric/acquisition stress tests; these papers do not prescribe our Y recipe. Global pixel changes do not imply semantic destruction, or guarantee preservation.

families.discovery: Separate RGB channel scale from chromatic balance; inspect current labels and pixels.
families.validation: Authorized palette permutation, grayscale/desaturation or channel scaling; paired evaluation with unchanged geometry.
families.limitations: IRM reports Colored-MNIST environments, not arbitrary-natural-image label guarantees; color can define the class.

families.discovery: Compare foreground and surrounding scene with training evidence.
families.validation: Frozen foreground segmentation and background replacement or approved scene swaps; foreground-only controls.
families.limitations: Masks may be wrong; model-protected foreground and SAM previews are not semantic certification.

families.cue: Watermark / logo / text marker / corner patch
families.discovery: Find repeated localized non-task marks; do not assume a corner or box from memory.
families.validation: Agent-localized mask, replacement, matched patch removal or position randomization; keep processing artifacts and content-loss controls.
families.limitations: Do not erase task-defining numerals or claim to recover occluded original pixels.

families.discovery: Review entropy and edge facts as potentially shared representations, plus visible object shape.
families.validation: Blur or frequency sensitivity is a diagnostic; faithful shape-texture cue-conflict / stylization needs approved construction and semantic checks.
families.limitations: Natural texture can be genuine task evidence; blur is not a faithful texture-only counterfactual.

families.discovery: Use structural descriptors as leads; inspect spectral changes if this hypothesis is selected.
families.validation: Bounded Fourier low/high-pass filtering and blur with paired no-op controls.
families.limitations: Frequency sensitivity is not alone a shortcut verdict; high-pass output is an engineering diagnostic adaptation.

families.discovery: Check observed orientation and spatial distribution independently from texture.
families.validation: Reflect-padded rotation or bounded spatial intervention; natural viewpoint transfer requires a separately approved dataset.
families.limitations: Rotation can change digit or directional labels; ObjectNet uses controlled real captures, not our synthetic renderer.

families.discovery: Inspect encoding facts and nuisance-quality differences without treating file size as a pixel cue.
families.validation: Recompression, blur, resolution and noise paired stress tests; report exact persistence round-trips.
families.limitations: Corruption robustness methods do not establish that every corruption is a shortcut; file size itself may never enter the classifier.

families.discovery: Inspect only approved acquisition metadata and pixel evidence.
families.validation: Approved source subgroup/external validation; visual style perturbations are proxies; true acquisition-source swapping needs authorized data.
families.limitations: Do not equate brightness or JPEG with a verified hospital/scanner source, or infer private source paths.

families.cue: Co-occurring object / treatment device / off-target marker
families.discovery: Localize visible contextual objects independently of target pathology/content.
families.validation: Mask/background intervention if localization is sound; domain expert semantic review required for medical conclusions.
families.limitations: Device removal can alter valid evidence or mask pathology; this library provides no clinical certification.

families.cue: Demographic or identity attribute correlated with target
families.discovery: Use permitted attribute groups and counterexamples; do not infer sensitive traits from identity/path.
families.validation: Approved subgroup/worst-group analysis; attribute counterfactual edits require validated domain-specific tools.
families.limitations: Protected attributes may be legitimate targets; editing identity cannot be promised by an image transform.

families.discovery: Inspect approved environment groups and distribution differences.
families.validation: Independent approved environment evaluation and worst-group metrics; source-group-disjoint splits when available.
families.limitations: Exact pixel uniqueness does not imply patient/site/geographic independence.

families.discovery: Inspect annotation protocols and available text, not labels embedded in paths.
families.validation: Hypothesis-only or cue-only baselines and hard subsets; text backend must be supplied.
families.limitations: Do not invoke image ResNet training as a text validation method.

families.discovery: Check text relations using current task evidence.
families.validation: HANS-style controlled minimal pairs and syntactic generalization; domain text generator/backend required.
families.limitations: Minimal edits can change the true inference label; do not retain labels without checking.

families.discovery: Inspect approved hashes and split assignments; identity fields are controls, not default shortcut hypotheses.
families.validation: Duplicate/subject-disjoint checks; correctly isolated retraining if leakage is established.
families.limitations: Leakage is a design failure distinct from a pixel nuisance cue; near-duplicate and subject detection are not yet certified.

cross_cutting.saliency: Use localization as a hypothesis lead only; perform model/data-randomization sanity checks when relying on saliency.
cross_cutting.early_stop: Keep the frozen primary effect, family error budget and reserved confirmation; do not tune using outcomes.
